name: Portmeirion Group PLC
summary: Portmeirion Group PLC manufactures, markets, and distributes ceramics, home fragrances, and associated homeware products in the United Kingdom, the United States, South Korea, and internationally. It offers tableware, cookware, giftware, glassware, and tabletop accessories under the Portmeirion, Spode, Wax Lyrical, Royal Worcester, Namb√É¬©, and Pimpernel brand names. The company provides home fragrance products, such as candles and diffusers; and bone China mugs, placemats, coasters, trays, accessories, and gifts. It is also involved in property business. The company sells its products directly to retailers and independent stores through a network of agents and distributors, as well as through its own retail shops and Websites. Portmeirion Group PLC was incorporated in 1912 and is headquartered in Stoke-on-Trent, the United Kingdom.
